about: S3 rule table. Code only: no model decides what is essential. Every question id names a fixed template in hass-npp-reply/reply-templates.json.

essentials.needed_when: is_product is false, or confidence.item is below min_confidence
essentials.question: ask_identity
essentials.note: Owner words or a clearer photo settle it. A guessed name is never published. When his made-by item name disagrees with a confident photo read and a confident label contradicts the maker he named, neither name is used and question_when_conflict asks him to say "it is …".

essentials.needed_when: no public price span tagged price by the caption parser, the price answer or the edit grammar, or the parse is in conflict, unresolved or ambiguous
essentials.question: ask_price_unit
essentials.note: Selling price is public but only ever the owner's words, in a span separate from any cost span (design 1.9). With no price and no unit said the one question is ask_price_unit (design 1.4); when his words already give the unit, ask_price.

essentials.needed_when: a price is known and its unit is ambiguous (basket rule, PR 1046: a basket or bundle price stays off the card until the owner says each)
essentials.question: ask_unit
essentials.note: Never invent a unit such as per lb for a jar.

omit_rules.brand_maker_town: Never asked for. Public only from the owner's own words or from the maker's verified official website (hass-maker-research); otherwise the card shows From the market and the renderer's own source line.
omit_rules.origin_line: Falls back to the renderer's own 'Ask us about the source in store.'
omit_rules.claims: Label claims are dropped with a one-line note unless the existing claims rule passes them.
omit_rules.category: Taken from S2 category_guess when confident; otherwise the default for the kind (food: pantry, drink: drinks, fresh: fruit, non-food: general). Household items go to general.

checks: read-only Clover cache name (local only, never sent to a cloud model)
duplicate_rule.on_hit: Say once that it looks like an existing listing and ask whether to add another, within the two-question budget. Never overwrite.

known_maker.match: exact after claims.fold of a producers.json key or name
known_maker.action: reuse the existing record, no web

near_match.match: fold-equal after removing punctuation and one plural s, not exact
near_match.question: ask_near_maker

contradiction.when: owner maker words and S2 brand_on_label share no folded token and S2 brand confidence is at least 0.8
contradiction.action: omit the maker, no research, reply bracket maker_left_off_label

new_maker.needs: a town from the owner's words or from the maker's verified official website

never: send a second reply to one message
combine_note: No combining step is needed: a missing price already carries the unit in one question.
